6965518070fe310007d69beb.name: Welcome and main menu

pathTools.name: Text response selected
pathTools.description: User selects Show Text Response button.

pathTools.name: Unrecognized input
pathTools.description: User says something that doesn't match any menu options.

6965518070fe310007d69beb.instructions: Greet the user, introduce the Voiceflow trace demo, and present the main menu using buttons for: Show Text Response, Show Card, Show Carousel, Trigger No-Reply, Speak (Voice), Show Image, and End Conversation. Use a Choice trace for the buttons. If the user says something unexpected, offer a fallback message and prompt them to choose one of the menu options.

6965518070fe310007d69bec.name: Unexpected input fallback

pathTools.name: Go to main menu
pathTools.description: Bring the user back to the main menu choices.

6965518070fe310007d69bec.instructions: Inform the user that their input wasn't recognized and politely prompt them to select one of the main menu options. Return them to the main menu.

6965518070fe310007d69bed.name: Show text response

pathTools.name: Return to main menu
pathTools.description: User clicks to return to the main menu after viewing the text response.

6965518070fe310007d69bed.instructions: Send a simple text message using a Text trace, such as 'This is a plain text response.' Briefly explain to the user they just experienced a Text trace. Prompt the user to return to the main menu with a button.

6965518070fe310007d69bee.name: Speak (voice) message

pathTools.name: Return to main menu
pathTools.description: User clicks a button to return to the main menu after the speak trace.

6965518070fe310007d69bee.instructions: Output clean spoken text using a Speak trace, e.g., 'This message is being spoken aloud using the Speak trace.' Explain this is how Voiceflow delivers audio or TTS responses. Offer a button to return the user to the main menu.

6965518070fe310007d69bef.name: Show image

pathTools.name: Return to main menu
pathTools.description: User clicks a button to return after viewing the image.

6965518070fe310007d69bef.instructions: Display an image using a Visual trace with a friendly message like, 'Here’s an example image using a Visual trace.' Include alt text. After this, provide a button to return to the main menu.

cardTool.description: Summarizes the assistant's response in a visual card with a title, image, description, and optional action buttons.

6965518070fe310007d69bf0.name: Show card

pathTools.name: Return to main menu
pathTools.description: User clicks the button in the card to return to the main menu.

6965518070fe310007d69bf0.instructions: Show a CardV2 trace with a nice title, an image, descriptive text that explains what a Card is, and at least one button that takes the user to the main menu. Example: 'CardV2 Demo', 'This is what a card looks like in Voiceflow.'

carouselTool.description: Displays a carousel of up to 10 cards, each containing a title, description, image, and optional action buttons.

6965518070fe310007d69bf1.name: Show carousel

pathTools.name: Return to main menu from carousel
pathTools.description: User interacts with a card button in the carousel to return to the main menu.

6965518070fe310007d69bf1.instructions: Display a Carousel trace showing at least two cards, each with its own image, title, and button clearly labeled to return to the main menu. Briefly explain that a Carousel lets users browse multiple cards. Any card interaction brings the user back to the main menu.

buttonTool.description: Displays a UI picker when the user needs to select one option from a predefined list (up to 5 options).

6965518070fe310007d69bf2.name: Trigger no-reply

pathTools.name: Timeout occurs, no-reply triggered
pathTools.description: No-reply is triggered when user does not respond.

pathTools.name: User responds
pathTools.description: User immediately gives a response before timeout.

6965518070fe310007d69bf2.instructions: Prompt the user with an open-ended question (like, 'What would you like to ask?'), then simulate a timeout using a No-Reply trace. After a short 'no reply' message, offer a button to return to the main menu.

6965518070fe310007d69bf3.name: No-reply follow-up

pathTools.name: Return to main menu
pathTools.description: User clicks a button to return after no-reply follow-up.

6965518070fe310007d69bf3.instructions: Let the user know that no reply was received and that this demonstrates the No-Reply trace. Then, offer a button for them to return to the main menu.

6965518070fe310007d69bf4.name: Response after no-reply question

pathTools.name: Return to main menu
pathTools.description: User decides to return after replying.

6965518070fe310007d69bf4.instructions: Acknowledge the user’s quick reply. Mention this normally triggers No-Reply if there’s no response. Offer a button to return to the main menu.

6965518070fe310007d69bf5.name: End conversation
6965518070fe310007d69bf5.instructions: Thank the user for exploring the Voiceflow trace types, wish them a great day, and end the flow.

sessions.description: The number of times a particular user has opened the app.

timestamp.description: UNIX timestamp (number of seconds since January 1st, 1970 at UTC).

platform.description: The platform your agent is running on (e.g. "voiceflow").

locale.description: The locale of the user (eg. en-US, en-CA, it-IT, fr-FR, ...).

intent_confidence.description: The confidence interval (measured as a value from 0 to 100) for the most recently matched intent.

last_response.description: The agent's last response (text/speak) in a string.

last_event.description: The object containing the last event that the user client has triggered.

last_utterance.description: The user's last utterance in a text string.

vf_memory.description:
Last 10 user inputs and agent responses in a string (e.g. "agent: How can i help?"
user: What's the weather today?).

vf_time.description: Current time in the format "16:37". You can modify the timezone in project settings.

vf_month.description: Current month in the format "January". You can modify the timezone in project settings.

vf_year.description: Current year in the format "2025". You can modify the timezone in project settings.

vf_now.description: Current date and time in the format "Jan 1, 2025, 16:37". You can modify the timezone in project settings.

vf_user_timezone.description: The user's timezone in the format "America/Toronto", if available. Defaults to the project timezone.

vf_weekday.description: Current day of week in the format "Monday". You can modify the timezone in project settings.

vf_transcript_id.description: The transcript ID of the current conversation. Only available if transcripts are enabled.

transcriptEvaluations.name: Deflection rate
transcriptEvaluations.prompt: Determine if the user requested to talk to a human in order to achieve their desired outcome.
transcriptEvaluations.truePrompt: The user did not require the need to talk to a human.
transcriptEvaluations.falsePrompt: The user required the need to talk to a human agent.

transcriptEvaluations.name: AI summary
transcriptEvaluations.prompt: Look at the transcript and provide a brief summary of the conversation. Make sure to highlight the outcome of the conversation, and key moments or topics, and the overall tone of the customer.

transcriptEvaluations.name: Satisfaction score
transcriptEvaluations.prompt: Rate the user's overall satisfaction based on the conversation, using a scale from 1 to 5.
transcriptEvaluations.minimumPrompt: Look for negative comments or expressions of dissatisfaction to rate the minimum satisfaction.
transcriptEvaluations.maximumPrompt: Identify any comments or phrases in the transcript that express the highest level of satisfaction.
